about_short_description.short_description: The easiest way for merchants to accept payments and convert customers.

product.name: Payments
product.description: A platform to accept various online payment methods including immediate and pay-later options, supporting local and international bank and card payments, digital wallets, and other popular payment methods.

product.name: Refunds
product.description: An automated refund system that accelerates and simplifies the refund process by enabling merchants to trigger refunds via admin panel, partner system, or API without manual transfers or delays.

product.name: Shipping
product.description: A shipping management solution that offers local delivery options, label printing, shipment tracking, and centralized management integrated with multiple carriers.

product.name: Montonio Partner System
product.description: A centralized management system for merchants to track payments, shipping, refunds, orders, and export business-critical data with real-time payment status updates.

product.name: Pay Later
product.description: A financing solution allowing customers to pay for purchases over time while merchants receive full payment upfront, supporting interest-free installments and flexible financing terms.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A tool to generate and send payment links to customers, enabling easy and direct payment collection outside of traditional checkout flows.
